en.stem: A 0.20 kg water sample loses 8400 J as it cools by 10 K. A 0.50 kg metal sample gains the same energy while warming by 40 K. Calculate the specific heat capacity of each and state one assumption.
en.answer: Water: c = Q/(mΔT) = 8400/(0.20×10) = 4200 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹ (2 marks). Metal: c = 8400/(0.50×40) = 420 J kg⁻¹ K⁻¹ (2 marks). Assumption: heat lost by water equals heat gained by metal, with negligible losses to surroundings (1 mark).
